connected_repairs.repair: Run existing cases with --nocapture and preserve combined output. Extend the existing verifier/acceptance accounting to reject or explicitly block native clearance on the exact source-backed no-GPU marker; do not change fixture bodies, invent a device probe, add a helper or silently accept self-skips. Capture any already emitted native cause/provider information; do not invent backend identity absent output.
